name: @openfairygui/backend
description: FairyGUI Headless Authoring SDK — stateful backend runtime and session services.
author: OpenFairyGUI Contributors

scripts.build: tsdown src/index.ts src/node.ts --format esm,cjs --platform node --external node:fs --external node:fs/promises --external node:path --env.PACKAGE_VERSION=$npm_package_version
scripts.build:watch: tsdown src/index.ts src/node.ts --watch --format esm,cjs --platform node --external node:fs --external node:fs/promises --external node:path --env.PACKAGE_VERSION=$npm_package_version
